DIAGNOSTIC DEFECT FOUND, RESOLVER DELIBERATELY LEFT UNCHANGED. mn_city_resolve.py line 153 sets circular=True from the _geo=="city_centroid" marker, and line 165 applies it even on the addr_hit branch. STEP 4.9 stamps that marker on 209 rows every build, so the pipeline erases its own coverage evidence. Measured this run: of 192 events returning centroid_circular, 173 have addresses that INDEPENDENTLY name a real gazetteer municipality - only 19 are genuinely coordinate-only. The spec's circularity concern applies when the city was DERIVED FROM the coordinate; when the address names the city, that is independent evidence and "the address wins" should govern. Coverage is therefore understated for 25 cities: Saint Paul +48, Minneapolis +35, Roseville +20, Shoreview +12 (would move from shortfall to meeting target), Wayzata +7, Edina/Golden Valley/New Brighton +5 each, White Bear Lake +4, Richfield/Brainerd/Bloomington +3 each. Published feed data is UNAFFECTED - this is diagnostic-only. Not changed unilaterally in an unattended run: it is a semantics change to a documented rule and deserves human ratification. Suggested fix: apply circular only on the coord_hit branch.
